subject: [hw] V03 start: ELF32 loader
body: Starting V03. Plan: n2elf.c (segments/dynamic/GNU hash/resolution/init), n2elf_reloc.c (REL, APS2 packed, RELR; 4 types), tests under loader/test_v03 with an ARM-object oracle harness. Until V02 posts DONE I use a local n2a32 stand-in (mmap-backed 4 GiB reservation, bump alloc, hostcall slots) under loader/test_v03/; run_tests.sh will switch to emu/*.c when V02 lands.
